title: The Purple Sand Photograph
paras: When a photograph of purple sand appeared on a coastal news website, readers feared pollution. The caption claimed that waste from a nearby [[corporation|corporation]] could damage the [[kidney|kidneys]]. Within hours, the beach café had lost its weekend bookings. Editor Leila Noor had not [[foresee|foreseen]] how quickly an unverified caption could affect the town.

Leila asked photographer Mateo Silva to find the exact location. One detail helped: a deep [[footprint|footprint]] beside a broken wooden post. They travelled along the coast in a [[registered|registered]] fishing boat and stepped [[ashore|ashore]] near an abandoned salt store. There, purple streaks covered the sand, but only beneath a row of torn sacks.

Leila sent samples for technicians to [[analyze|analyze]]. She also interviewed a former storekeeper whose poor [[vision|vision]] prevented him from reading the faded labels. He remembered storing [[excess|excess]] powder left over from colouring building materials. Tests identified the same type of powder; streaks beneath the sacks suggested rain had washed it out. The colour alone did not establish that industrial waste was entering the sea.

The website published a correction explaining the findings. Leila was [[considerate|considerate]] towards the original contributor, explaining the mistake without naming him. She also introduced a rule requiring evidence for health claims. After the sacks were removed and the beach inspected, the café reopened its terrace. Its first busy Sunday offered a practical sign that trust was returning.
zh: 一张紫色沙滩的照片出现在一家海岸新闻网站上后，读者担心这里发生了污染。图片说明声称，附近一家大公司的废弃物可能损害肾脏。几小时内，海滩咖啡馆就失去了周末的预订。编辑莱拉·努尔没有预料到，一条未经核实的图片说明会这么快影响整个小镇。
莱拉请摄影师马特奥·席尔瓦找出照片的确切拍摄地点。一个细节帮了忙：一根断裂木桩旁有个深深的脚印。他们乘坐一艘已登记的渔船沿海岸寻找，在一座废弃盐仓附近上了岸。那里的沙地上布满紫色条纹，但只出现在一排破袋子的下方。
莱拉把样本送去供技术人员分析。她还采访了一位以前的仓库管理员。他视力不好，看不清褪色的标签。他记得曾存放给建筑材料着色后剩下的多余粉末。检测鉴定出样本是同一类粉末；袋子下方的条纹则表明，粉末可能是被雨水冲出来的。单凭这种颜色，无法确定有工业废弃物正在进入海洋。
网站刊登了更正，解释调查结果。莱拉体谅最初的投稿者，解释错误时没有公布他的姓名。她还制定了一项规定，要求涉及健康的说法必须有证据支持。袋子被移走、海滩接受检查后，咖啡馆重新开放了露台。随后迎来的第一个忙碌的星期日，切实表明人们的信任正在恢复。

q.s: The website's report had a rapid effect on a local business.
q.why: 报道发布数小时内，咖啡馆便失去周末预订。

q.s: Leila paid for the laboratory tests herself.
q.why: 文中提到送检，但未说明谁支付检测费。

q.s: Leila named the original contributor when explaining the mistake.
q.why: 文中明确说她解释错误时没有公布他的姓名。
